input.fieldInvalid: Use a unique field key beginning with a letter, followed by letters, digits or underscores.
input.fieldNameHelp: Stable key for mappings and API calls, for example amount or customerId.
input.help: Define the data supplied by a form, module or API. The test form uses these fields. Steps sharing this schema use the same data contract.
input.valueInvalid: Check the field value and the input JSON.
inspector.actionHelp: Only registered read and workspace-write actions are available.
inspector.agentHelp: Published workflows keep this exact revision.
inspector.approvalRoleHelp: A workspace role. Members holding it may decide; the role must exist when the workflow is published.
inspector.approvalScopeHelp: Optional. Members must also hold this permission.
inspector.decisionAnswersHelp: Comma separated. A list for a choice, ordered lowest to highest for a scale.
inspector.decisionDecidingHelp: Its answer chooses the pass or the fail port. A yes-or-no answer carries no confidence and cannot decide.
inspector.decisionHelp: Questions this node asks about its input. The deciding answer routes the branch; the others are asked in the same request.
inspector.decisionPassHelp: Any other answer takes the fail port.
inspector.decisionStateHelp: Comma separated paths of this node input. Only these fields are sent to the provider.
inspector.decisionThresholdHelp: Below it the node takes the fail port and records the reason. Pinned with the published revision.
inspector.detailsHelp: Configure this step or connection. Changes are saved automatically.
inspector.empty: Select a node or connection to inspect it.
inspector.gatePointerHelp: The gate passes when this path exists in its input.
inspector.label: Label
inspector.mappingsHelp: Map an upstream typed envelope without executable code.
inspector.noAgentTools: This agent revision does not expose any tools.
inspector.removeNodeDescription: Its connections are removed from this draft as well.
inspector.retryOnHelp: Comma-separated stable failure codes. Leave empty to disable retries.
inspector.retryPolicyHelp: Bounded retries use recorded backoff. Exhaustion either follows the failure port or fails the run.
inspector.toolGrantsHelp: Choose the exact tools this node may use. Publication pins this set to the agent revision.
liveConfirm.description: The published revision may call providers and registered workspace actions under your current permissions.

mapping.help: Choose which data this step receives. Without mappings, the connected input passes through unchanged.
mapping.invalid: Check the JSON, field paths and upstream sources. The mapping was not saved.
mapping.literalHelp: JSON value, for example 42, true, or "text".
mapping.pointerHelp: Leave empty for the whole document. Use /name for a field. A single / means an empty field name.
mapping.variablesHelp: Each variable names an upstream node, output port and field path. Values are substituted once; no code is executed.
